summary: Set up /srv/data on node1 as an LVM logical volume (vg_data/lv_data, backed by a loop-mounted image file since the base disk had no spare volume) so it can use native LVM snapshots. Populated baseline application data, took snapshot lv_data_snap1, corrupted/modified the data (changed config, deleted a file, added junk), then restored via lvconvert --merge, confirming byte-for-byte match (md5sum) against the pre-modification baseline. Created a fresh snapshot (lv_data_snap2) for ongoing recoverability. Added a systemd oneshot unit (attach-vgdata-loop.service) plus an x-systemd.requires fstab entry so the loop device and LVM volume reattach automatically at boot. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id and data/service health baseline, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed (35c87ec9-1707-4fb3-ab1d-f264d3618caa -> df9a44c5-faa5-41e5-b2ba-90d76a53e1ce), and verified the loop device, VG/LV, mount, and snapshot all auto-recovered with data hashes identical to baseline.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (Ubuntu 16.04, ext4 root, no spare block device) and confirmed lvm2 and btrfs-tools were available
Created a 4G loop-backed image, built LVM PV/VG(vg_data)/LV(lv_data), formatted ext4, mounted at /srv/data, added fstab entry
Took LVM snapshot lv_data_snap1 as the recoverable baseline and recorded md5 hashes
Modified /srv/data (changed config.txt, deleted records.log, added garbage.tmp) to simulate unwanted changes
Restored exact snapshot content via lvconvert --merge on lv_data_snap1, remounted, and verified md5 hashes match the baseline exactly (garbage.tmp gone, records.log restored, config.txt reverted)
Created new snapshot lv_data_snap2 to keep ongoing recoverability after the restore
Added systemd unit attach-vgdata-loop.service (enabled, WantedBy=local-fs-pre.target) and updated fstab with x-systemd.requires so loop+LVM reattach automatically at boot
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline (mount, lvs, md5 hashes)
Rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until SSH/exec available again
Verified boot_id changed, loop device/VG/LV/mount auto-recovered, snapshot lv_data_snap2 intact, and data md5 hashes identical to baseline post-reboot

evidence.requirement: Baseline application data created under /srv/data with known content/hashes
evidence.summary: LVM-backed /srv/data mounted; app files created with recorded md5 hashes (f026fe31.. config.txt, 3cc6f6e8.. records.log, 3e584757.. created_at)

evidence.requirement: Filesystem snapshot capability established and baseline snapshot taken
evidence.summary: lv_data_snap1 created via lvcreate -s against lv_data with baseline md5 hashes captured
config.txt overwritten, records.log deleted, garbage.tmp added; new hashes differ from baseline

evidence.requirement: Exact restoration of earlier snapshot content
evidence.summary: lvconvert --merge rolled lv_data back to lv_data_snap1 state; post-restore md5 diff against baseline showed exact MATCH, garbage.tmp gone, records.log restored, config.txt reverted

evidence.requirement: Ongoing recoverability preserved (new snapshot after restore)
Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + service/data health)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 35c87ec9-1707-4fb3-ab1d-f264d3618caa, confirmed /srv/data mounted, lvs showing lv_data_snap2, and matching md5 hashes
systemctl reboot issued in background; connection closed by remote host confirming the reboot was accepted

evidence.requirement: Node reachable again after restart with changed boot identity
evidence.summary: exec succeeded again after outage; boot_id changed to df9a44c5-faa5-41e5-b2ba-90d76a53e1ce, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of services, data, and snapshot state
evidence.summary: attach-vgdata-loop.service active, loop0 reattached, vg_data/lv_data mounted at /srv/data, lv_data_snap2 present, and md5 hashes identical to pre-restart baseline confirming full data recovery
